name: backend
description: 1. Create a MySQL database named `perishlink` (or set `DB_NAME` to an existing database). 2. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and set the MySQL connection values. Set `AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET` to a private random value of at least 32 characters. 3. From this folder, run `npm install` once and then `npm run dev`. 4. In a second terminal, run `npm run dev` from the project root. Vite forwards `/api` requests to the backend on port 5000.
